questions.stem: A swimming pool has a trapezoidal cross-section with parallel sides $1\text{ m}$ and $2.5\text{ m}$, width $6\text{ m}$, and length $25\text{ m}$. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Trapezoidal cross-section area $= \frac{1}{2}(1 + 2.5) \times 6 = \frac{1}{2} \times 3.5 \times 6 = 10.5\text{ m}^2$. Volume $= 10.5 \times 25 = 262.5\text{ m}^3$.
